headline: KeyBanc Capital Markets to Acquire Atlantic-Pacific Capital
summary: KeyBanc Capital Markets has agreed to acquire Atlantic-Pacific Capital, expanding KeyCorp's reach into global fund placement, direct private placement, and secondary advisory services.
why: KeyBanc Capital Markets is the corporate and investment banking unit of KeyCorp, a major U.S. bank holding company. M&A activity in the financial sector drives consolidation and expands advisory capabilities for institutional clients.
